name: denubis-local-mail
description: PostgreSQL-backed mail tools for collaborating local Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Low-interruption mail for collaborating local agents.
interface.longDescription: Route durable peer messages by subject and thread, notify once at Stop, and pull bodies only when relevant while keeping supervised-agent control separate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up local mail for the collaborating worktrees in this project.
